story.title: What happens if an entire class of workers loses faith in their careers

draft:
I've been noticing a trend of discontent among tech professionals. 
A recent article on Noema Magazine explores this phenomenon, citing burnout and lack of fulfillment. 
As someone in the industry, I've seen colleagues leave for non-tech roles.
What's driving this exodus and how can we address it?
#techcareers #burnout #futureofwork
